title: Original native lease request bound to its measured current holder
description: Explicit outer profile, bounded to 96 KiB including its separately named native broker inner request. Only the root-authorized ciphertext-only cold profile admits this outer family. Cold authority selection, canonical signature verification under the actual registered key, original HTTP nonce and protected current root are runtime requirements. No schema result grants registration or secret release.

dispatchPin.description: Epoch must equal the original inner expectedCredentialVersion. The dedicated signature preimage includes all original inner fields, not a Pydantic projection or just its recipient ID. Canonical unpadded base64url and actual signature ownership are independently enforced.
